boxMapping: The Figma frame's horizontal extent maps to the row's content box (the owned Item supplies px-3 that the Figma composition keeps outside the row), and its vertical extent maps to the padding box (56 = 12 + 32 + 12). Element offsets are measured from the content-box origin, which is why the media/mark offset is 0 rather than the frame's 12.

capture.cropReason: Padding box is 348x56; cropping its 12px padding-left and using the shared 324px width yields the same origin as the Figma frame (mark at x0), so the capture and the reference describe the same region.

diff.cropReason: The 324-wide shared box: the Figma frame is hug-width 326, the shipped row's content column is 324 at a 390 wide viewport (F4 in audit.md). The 2px delta is recorded in verification/balances-row.json, not tuned away.

elements.name: frame
elements.notes: Figma frame width vs the row's content width (2px hug-vs-stretch finding F4); Figma frame height vs the row's padding-box height (12 + 32 + 12, matches).

elements.name: card
